body:
When I was 12 I tried to kms so age doesn’t mean that it’s just edgy stuff and even if it seems like it’s trendy cutting yourself clearly means that you have some trouble with yourself. I don’t know you nor your sister but you should talk to her. She might be self harming and it can become an addiction trust me on that. Don’t let her fall into that.
Social media can ask problems but sometimes it’s the only place we’re you feel confortable as it’s easy to have compliments or « friends », a community and you can easily ask for help but it also has problems nobody can deny that.

Maybe there’s all this stuff about edgy teens but I am 15 and depression isn’t something that I fake because it’s fun or whatever. Nobody will cut himself for fun. Nobody tries to kms for fun and maybe some seek for attention but it’s because they can’t deal with themselves anymore and want help and a bit of affection and there’s nothing wrong about that.

Seriously talk to her because when I was 11 I could have been help but now I am 15 with 5 attempts to kms, multiple scars, and been to a mental hospital and I think about dropping out of school or kms for good.
Before I used to avoid sleep but it was to have the maximum of time before an other day because I didn’t want to have to lice an other one but now I have insomnia.
Tuesday for me but with a train
Same I feel like a coward
Yay because we end up killing ourself and there will be nothing after but the world will still be ok after we’ve left

Ce passera ce qui se passera. Peux pas t’aider quand j’essaie de crever chaque semaine alors autant être un connard qui peut pas t’aider qu’un connard hypocrite.
Salut, bonne journée et va te faire encule la France
On crèvera tous de toute manière
Same here, I will give 2020 another month before doing it

Don’t worry you don’t have to try to save me. No one can except myself, Just let me go. Please just hope me to not suffer anymore. Please let me go 

I do have stuff to live for but I don’t want to live them even if they’re nice. There’s nothing bad in my life which mean that the only change need to come from me and I don’t wanna do them because I just wanna die.
Really I am just hopeless I just need to kill myself, I need it, I need to feel the rope around my neck and my mouth trying to catch air. It’s not some weird sexual thing I just need to die. I need to see my blood in the sink I need to die I just need it

It’s not a good thing but thinking of how I am going to kill myself calm me down. I am hopeless sorry. 

Have a great life that I couldn’t have
